title: 第五章推演
novel_title: 开局阴阳宗，从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
张守安站起身来，穿戴好衣物，眼前自动弹出界面。

    【宿主境界提升】

    【目前境界：练气大成】

    【击杀练气大成人类】

    【价值评估中…】

    【价值：200点道行值】

    不错，张守安对这些收获还算满意，算上之前剩余的道行值，现在足足有214点道行值了。

    正好试试系统的推演功能，不过在此之前……

    他的目光落在了江燕的储物袋里。

    是舔包的时候了。

    他一阵摸索，翻出了几枚丹药，一封书信还有本书籍。

    张守安简单扫了几眼丹药，眼前自动浮现了丹药信息。

    【龙虎壮阳丹】

    【练气初期药物，服用后短时间内精力充沛，气血充盈。但药效过后会出现轻微腰膝酸软，经脉可能受损。】

    这个好像是给我用的……

    张守安沉默了几秒，了解利弊后，还是默默收好。

    【驻颜丹】

    【女子服用，有美容功效。】

    【金髓锻骨丹】

    【练气大成药物，使用后，引金属灵力入体，捶打经脉，消化后，大幅提升肉身强度与经脉韧性。】

    【注：搭配功法使用，效果更佳。】

    终于来了一个有用的，张守安小心装好，而后翻开了那本书籍。

    【白青罡气(练气)(残)】

    【世间之气，不计其数，取其中青白二气，存于自身灵海，必要时可化为护体罡气，亦或者剑身上的罡气。】

    【由于是残篇，无法修炼。】

    这个好，张守安大致浏览了一遍，系统自动存入信息。

    【白青罡气(练气)(残)(入门)】

    系统说是残篇无法修炼，但要是我推演出完整功法，那……

    他越想越觉得可能，不过他还是稍稍压下心中的激动，目光落在那封书信上。

    看完再试试吧。

    “燕子亲启”

    给江燕的……那我这么做是不是不好，但眼睛却是诚实地向下浏览。

    “燕子，我已经和父亲商量过，在你突破后，我会来娶你的。”

    “不知你是否喜欢我送你的炉鼎，这可是我精心挑选的，此人可是绝佳的双修体质，我为此费了好些功夫。”
content_en:
Zhang Shouan stood up, put on his clothes, and an interface automatically popped up in front of him.

    [Host realm improvement]

    [Current state: Complete Qi training]

    [Kill an adult human who practices Qi]

    【Under evaluation...】

    [Value: 200 Taoist points]

    Yes, Zhang Shou'an is quite satisfied with these gains. Counting the remaining Daoxing points before, he now has a full 214 Daoxing points.

    It's time to try out the system's deduction function, but before that...

    His eyes fell on Jiang Yan's storage bag.

    It's time to lick the bag.

    He groped for a while and found several pills, a letter and a book.

    Zhang Shouan glanced at the elixir briefly, and the elixir information automatically appeared in front of his eyes.

    【Dragon Tiger Aphrodisiac Pill】

    [The medicine in the early stage of Qi training will make you energetic and full of Qi and blood within a short period of time after taking it. However, after the effect of the medicine wears off, you may experience slight soreness and weakness in your waist and knees, and your meridians may be damaged. 】

    This seems to be for me...

    Zhang Shou'an was silent for a few seconds. After understanding the pros and cons, he quietly put it away.

    【Zhu Yan Dan】

    [If taken by women, it has beauty effects. 】

    【Golden Marrow Bone Forging Pill】

    [Qi-training medicine, after use, draws metal spiritual power into the body and beats the meridians. After digestion, it greatly improves the strength of the physical body and the toughness of the meridians. 】

    [Note: Use it in conjunction with the exercises for better results. 】

    Finally, a useful one came. Zhang Shouan installed it carefully, and then opened the book.

    [Bai Qinggang Qi (qi training) (disabled)]

    [There are countless qi in the world. Take the blue and white qi and store them in your own spiritual sea. When necessary, you can turn them into body-protecting qi or the sword's qi. 】

    [Because it is a fragment, it cannot be practiced. 】

    This is good. Zhang Shouan browsed it briefly, and the system automatically stored the information.

    [Bai Qinggang Qi (Qi Training) (Disabled) (Introduction)]

    The system says that it is a fragment and cannot be practiced, but if I can deduce the complete method, then...

    The more he thought about it, the more he thought it was possible, but he still suppressed the excitement in his heart and his eyes fell on the letter.

    Try it after watching it.

    "Swallow's kiss"

    For Jiang Yan... So is it bad for me to do this, but my eyes are browsing down honestly.

    "Yanzi, I have discussed it with my father. After you break through, I will come to marry you."

    "I wonder if you like the cauldron I gave you. I carefully selected this. This person has an excellent dual cultivation physique. I spent a lot of effort on it."
